dimensions.assessment: Affects securities issuers, non-affiliate common equity holders, and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
dimensions.evidence: an issuer shall be a 'well-known seasoned issuer' if... the aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates of the issuer is $400,000,000 or more

dimensions.assessment: Expands eligibility for expedited public offerings through automatic shelf registrations to issuers meeting the lower $400 million threshold.
dimensions.evidence: A well-known seasoned issuer is allowed to make expedited public offerings of securities through automatic shelf registrations.

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are stated, though it alters securities registration processes.
Amends federal securities laws definitions and regulations regarding well-known seasoned issuers and adds SEC annual reporting duties.
dimensions.evidence: For purposes of the Federal securities laws, and regulations issued thereunder, an issuer shall be a well-known seasoned issuer if...

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to WKSI qualifications alongside ongoing annual SEC reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: The Securities and Exchange Commission shall, not later than 90 days after the end of each calendar year, publish the total number of applications submitted...

missing_information: Exact number of additional companies expected to qualify under the lowered threshold
importance_detail.rationale: Reduces the required aggregate market value threshold for securities issuers to qualify as well-known seasoned issuers (WKSIs) to $400 million and requires the SEC to publish annual reports on withdrawn WKSI eligibility applications.
